name: Express.js
description: Express helps you build web APIs quickly. This learning track uses modular layers, request validation, error handling, and a mini project-ready API pattern.

snippets.title: Project Structure for Express API Learning
snippets.codeDes: Layer your API from route to controller to service to keep endpoints easy to test and extend.
snippets.code:
bookmarks-api/
  src/
    app.js
    server.js
    routes/bookmarkRoutes.js
    controllers/bookmarkController.js
    services/bookmarkService.js
    middleware/errorHandler.js
    middleware/validate.js
    middleware/apiKeyAuth.js
    schemas/bookmarkSchemas.js
  tests/

  package.json

snippets.title: Install Dependencies
snippets.codeDes: Install Express and common API helpers for logging, CORS, environment config, and schema validation.
snippets.code:
npm init -y
npm install express cors morgan dotenv zod
npm install -D supertest

snippets.title: Bootstrap App with Middlewares (src/app.js)
snippets.codeDes: Register middleware once in app.js, then keep server startup in a separate file.
snippets.code:
import express from 'express'
import cors from 'cors'
import morgan from 'morgan'
import bookmarkRoutes from './routes/bookmarkRoutes.js'
import { errorHandler } from './middleware/errorHandler.js'

const app = express()
app.use(cors())
app.use(express.json())
app.use(morgan('dev'))
app.get('/health', (_req, res) => res.json({ ok: true }))
app.use('/api/bookmarks', bookmarkRoutes)
app.use(errorHandler)

export default app

snippets.title: Zod Validation Middleware (src/middleware/validate.js)
snippets.codeDes: Validate input at route boundaries and fail fast with useful errors.

snippets.title: Bookmark Schema and Routes (src/routes/bookmarkRoutes.js)
snippets.codeDes: Pair input schemas with route declarations for predictable endpoint behavior.
snippets.code:
import { Router } from 'express'
import * as controller from '../controllers/bookmarkController.js'
import { validate } from '../middleware/validate.js'
import { createBookmarkSchema } from '../schemas/bookmarkSchemas.js'

const router = Router()
router.get('/', controller.listBookmarks)
router.post('/', validate(createBookmarkSchema), controller.createBookmark)
export default router

snippets.title: Controller + Service Pattern
snippets.codeDes: Controllers stay HTTP-focused while services contain business rules.

snippets.title: Central Error Handler (src/middleware/errorHandler.js)
snippets.codeDes: Use one error handler to enforce consistent response format across all routes.

snippets.title: Mini Project: API Key Middleware (src/middleware/apiKeyAuth.js)

snippets.title: Integration Test with Supertest (tests/bookmarks.test.js)
snippets.codeDes: Verify core route behavior quickly with real HTTP requests against your app object.

snippets.title: Server Entrypoint (src/server.js)
snippets.codeDes: Keep process startup separate from app configuration for easier testing.

snippets.title: Run Express API Locally
snippets.codeDes: Use a server entrypoint and environment file to run your mini project consistently.
